A dedicated Business Analyst will institutionalize research and documentation practices, improve the quality and speed of deliverables, and provide structured analytical support across both project and product initiatives.

  • Bachelor's Degree in IT, Computer Science, Computer Engineering and related technical discipline
  • 2-3 years of prior work experience in BA roles.

Job Description

  • Conduct research and feasibility studies - market analysis, vendor evaluation, regulatory review, and benchmarking.
  • Conduct structured requirement workshops, interviews, and walkthroughs with stakeholders to capture, refine, and sign off on business and functional requirements.
